name: Conservation Corps summer youth program
org: Forest Preserves of Cook County (listed by Cook County government)
what_you_do: A paid summer crew job outdoors. Teens get job training, do hard service work and join nature activities in the forest preserves.
pay_detail: Paid: $15 an hour (CCLC) or $15.50 (Forest Preserve Experience) per the Forest Preserves page. Transportation and service clothing are provided.
deadline_text: Forest Preserves page: youth applications are due in April. 2027 dates not posted.
how_to_apply: The Cook County page points to fpdcc.com/nature/conservation-corps-programs for how to apply. That page was not available.
notes: Confirm age rules, pay and deadline on the Forest Preserves site, because it blocked my reader. Ask about working papers if you are under 16.
